does: Creates an empty AI score (the reference-counted esv::AiScore body: 0x38 bytes, flags, an 11-bucket map of per-entity values) and stores it in the handle it is given.

evidence.says: allocates 0x38 bytes and a 0x58-byte bucket table, zeroes them and rehashes into 11 buckets
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 63 places in the AI scoring code

questions.ask: A probe during an enemy's turn that reads the handle after the call would show the empty score: its flags, its reference count and its empty map.
